about_the_game:
The Muhe civilization is an unobservable, incomprehensible, and difficult to access unknown advanced civilization.

In a corner of the world, a researcher of the Mu He civilization is holding up the seventh wonder creation of the Mu He civilization. A long rod is welded onto a flat disc without a magnifying effect device, aggregating endless energy onto a thin tin foil board.

The Xiguang civilization finally gave birth to the greatest ruler in history during endless wars, named Xiguang. In the mind of this iron blooded leader, the Xiguang civilization is a super large war civilization that unifies the entire world community. She will lead her people on a journey of exploration into the endless void.

Under the iron and blood rule of the great Xiguang, countless fleets rushed into the void, attempting to burn the tin cardboard of the Xiguang civilization to the end of the world. Originally, the raging flames of civilization would surely destroy the barrier of the void dimension, and void creatures would submit to the artillery fire of the civilization fleet until that day arrived...

The highest command center. Trembling voices, angry roars, one after another. The people of tin foil are rapidly compiling data on all natural disasters in the world of tin foil, calculating the probability of natural disasters occurring, and calculating the probability of civilization rulers being hit by natural disasters!

0.000000000001%.

This means that the black light pillar that runs through the sky and earth in front of us is not a natural disaster, and the fact that the Lord of Xiguang was submerged under the black light pillar is not an accidental event! The unknown enemy launched a fatal blow to the Xiguang civilization through unknown means. This is a zero sum war! The war that affected the entire Xiguang civilization has erupted!
